notes: - **The projection now articulates**: setting any of the new drivers (`payout_ratio_pct`, `buyback_pct_fcf`, `target_leverage`) switches a model into three-statement mode — earnings → retained earnings → equity; capex − D&A → net fixed assets; working-capital deltas and FCF less dividends and buybacks → cash; **interest recomputed from average net debt** (fixed-point), so a leveraged company's operating deltas compound through the balance sheet instead of paying interest on a frozen opening number. - **The tie is a test, not a hope**: assets = liabilities + equity is enforced in EVERY projecte
